about: Ground truth for the outside pass: W3C WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices (APG) example pages, fetched from https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/ at run time and never committed. Every labelled trigger is a W3C reference implementation, so every row is a clean control: a finding on it from W1 or the focus reviewer is a false flag. Written on 2026-11-01 before any model call on these pages (one walk of the dialog page had already run, to check that the pages can be walked; walks make no model call). Triggers are matched by accessible name; findings on the site's own header, footer and code-sample controls are reported separately and are not scored.
